content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya often face barriers with platforms like PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-13|stripe]], making it difficult to sell their products. Traditional platforms charge exorbitant fees, often up to 10% per sale. In contrast, you can establish your digital store using COREMERCH’s infrastructure at a fraction of the cost, ensuring you retain more of your earnings while embracing cryptocurrency payments. This guide provides a step-by-step approach to launching your digital products without relying on restrictive payment systems.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built specifically for creators who are locked out of conventional payment systems. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-15|NOWPayments Integration]] for automatic crypto payment processing, you avoid high platform fees and restrictions. With only a 0.5% fee compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%, you retain more profits. Real-world testing in countries with currency instability and payment rejections proves that this infrastructure is reliable and independent, empowering creators to control their income.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your digital store, gather your digital products—[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-step-step-deployment-guide-23|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]], courses, templates, or any digital assets you plan to sell. Ensure they are ready for upload to your hosting platform. Set up a crypto wallet compatible with NOWPayments to receive payments seamlessly. Familiarize yourself with tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, as well as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. This preparation will streamline your deployment and ensure a smooth launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

After you've prepared your digital products, set up your payment and delivery pipeline. Deploy your store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure NOWPayments for automatic payment processing, ensuring you can accept various cryptocurrencies. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage and delivery. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your products once payment is confirmed. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly, enhancing their experience and building trust.
Retain more revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your store set up and your payment pipeline operational, it’s time to go live. Share your store URL with your audience and promote your products through social media and other channels. When a customer makes a purchase, monitor the transaction through NOWPayments. The moment the payment confirms on-chain, your automated delivery system will trigger, sending the product directly to the buyer. This streamlined process not only saves time but also maximizes customer satisfaction.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is live, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze your sales data to understand which products perform best and adjust your marketing strategies accordingly. Consider expanding your product line or creating bundle offers to attract more customers. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the blueprints and templates you need to enhance your store further. Leverage the scalability of your infrastructure to capitalize on growing demand without incurring high costs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize blockchain technology with a platform like NOWPayments. With this setup, you can accept various cryptocurrencies and retain more of your earnings. This approach eliminates platform fees and gives you complete control over your sales process, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
Accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction costs.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital products such as templates or fonts without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit offers everything you need to build and manage your sovereign digital commerce stack effortlessly, while keeping your profits intact.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Utilize NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments directly. Set up your digital storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your products. Ensure automated delivery of your ebooks upon payment confirmation to enhance customer experience.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to use COREMERCH’s infrastructure that integrates NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, retaining more revenue compared to traditional platforms.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by deploying your store with COREMERCH’s tools, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. This approach maximizes your earnings.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments in Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and many others. This flexibility ensures you cater to a broad audience.
Can I automate the delivery of my digital products?
Absolutely. By using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery process, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
Automate delivery to enhance customer satisfaction and trust.
